description: Reviews the signed-in user's own CV: send its full text (read it from the file or message they shared; do not rewrite it). Returns a score out of 100 in four parts (impact, clarity, fit to the field, complete and up to date), what it does well, the most important fixes (with a better version of weak lines that keeps the same facts) and honest upgrades. Advice never invents experience. Only call it after the user agrees to have their CV reviewed by AI. Only the CV's lines and the review are kept (private to the user), not the whole text. The returned report id can start a mock interview about this CV (start_mock_interview). The user can see it at https://foundaree.com/cv.

role.description: The role they are aiming for, if they said.

text.description: The CV's full text, exactly as written.
